preconditions.description: Number of groups is between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(group[0]) <= 100 for group in stdin.strip().split('\n')[1:])
preconditions.description: Number of friends in each group is between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(friend) <= 100 for group in stdin.strip().split('\n')[1:] for friend in group[1:].split())
preconditions.description: Each friend's label is between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(int(friend) != i for i, group in enumerate(stdin.strip().split('\n')[1:], start=1) for friend in group[1:].split())
preconditions.description: A friend cannot be in his/her own friend list.

postconditions.description: Output contains exactly two values: the most popular friend's label and the average distance.
The most popular friend's label is between 1 and 100.
The average distance is rounded to six decimal places.
